title: Variance-Optimal State Resampling for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.15888v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards spends much of its rollout budget on states that yield no learning signal. We recast this as a question about the sampling distribution itself: under a fixed rollout budget, which distribution over states minimizes the variance of the policy-gradient estimator? The answer admits a closed-form Neyman allocation, $\mu_{\mathrm{var}}^\pi(s) \propto d^\pi(s)\,\sigma_\pi(s)$, which connects naturally to GRPO's group-relative advantage and induces an emergent reverse curriculum as the policy improves, with no externally imposed schedule. Building on this principle, we propose VSR (Variance-driven State Resampling), a plug-in modification to GRPO using a prefix replay buffer and a zero-cost variance proxy. On mathematical reasoning benchmarks and long-horizon agentic tasks (Sokoban, BabyAI), VSR outperforms GRPO and GiGPO on most benchmarks with fewer generated tokens per update.

translated_title: 面向可验证奖励强化学习的方差最优状态重采样
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习将大量的rollout预算花费在不产生学习信号的状态上。我们将这一问题重新表述为关于采样分布本身的问题：在固定的rollout预算下，哪种状态分布能够最小化策略梯度估计器的方差？该问题的答案是一个闭式解的Neyman分配：μ_var^π(s) ∝ d^π(s)σ_π(s)，它与GRPO的组相对优势自然相衔接，并随着策略的提升自发地产生一种逆向课程学习，无需外部强加的调度方案。基于这一原理，我们提出了VSR（方差驱动的状态重采样），它是对GRPO的一种即插即用式改进，利用前缀重放缓冲区和零成本的方差代理实现。在数学推理基准和长时程智能体任务上，VSR在大多数基准上以每次更新更少的生成token数超越了GRPO和GiGPO。
tldr: 该论文提出方差驱动的状态重采样（VSR），基于Neyman分配将rollout预算最优地集中于高方差状态，作为GRPO的即插即用改进，在数学推理和智能体任务上以更少的生成token超越了GRPO和GiGPO。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Variance-driven State Resampling (VSR), a plug-in GRPO modification that optimally allocates rollout budget to high-variance states via a closed-form Neyman allocation, outperforming GRPO and GiGPO on math reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks with fewer generated tokens per update.
